notes.title: Rating system | Update 1.2
notes.content: Update 1.2 introduces a brand-new rating system in Cafe Keeper! Now you have even more incentive to provide top-notch service to every guest. By increasing your rating, you can secure partnerships with soda brands and sell their products in your café. Improve your service, attract more customers, and grow your business!

notes.title: Fresh Update: New Recipe Unlock System and Gameplay Enhancements!
notes.content:
We’ve revamped the recipe unlock system: now, every new recipe is a delightful surprise! Enjoy the thrill of discovering recipes with a new cooking slot-machine interface. Product price tags are now color-coded: cheap items are marked with green text, while expensive ones are marked with red. We’ve also upgraded the character controller to minimize getting stuck and fixed numerous bugs for a smoother gameplay experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301675/5b59e15f14b9009dd2c4c52741ae6f4fef7e6d7e.png[/img]

notes.title: Customer Emotions
notes.content:
In addition to the new emotions, the game has become much more convenient. 

[h1][/h1] Now, the store doesn't delete the shopping list when closed.
[h1][/h1] Font issues where they blended with UI elements have been fixed.
[h1][/h1] The tutorial has become clearer.

And many other improvements have been made.
